title: PCR/qPCR prep: distribution of patient samples to 384-well plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Define sample distribution parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol parameters, set the number of patient sample plates (up to three), enter the columns to fill for each plate as a comma‑separated string of values between 1 and 12 (e.g., "8,8,12"), choose the 384‑well plate labware, and set the pipette disposal volume (default 1 µL).

steps.title: Download generated protocol file
steps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to obtain the Python protocol file that will run on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, create a new protocol run, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map: up to three 384‑well plates, a tip rack of Opentrons 20 µL filter tips, and the P20‑multi‑channel GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, each 384‑well plate, and the P20‑multi‑channel pipette; use the recommended calibration tips as described in the support article.

steps.title: Execute the distribution protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App; the robot will distribute patient samples to the specified columns of each 384‑well plate using the P20‑multi‑channel pipette and 20 µL filter tips, following the attached plate map.
